source: T. Siefke et al., Adv. Opt. Mater. 4, 1780-1786 (2016); ALD TiO2, 350 nm film; table via refractiveindex.info (CC0), TiO2_Siefke2016_nk.csv
model: eps = eps_inf + sum_j B_j lam^2/(lam^2 - lam_j^2 - 1j*g_j*(lam_j/lam)**P*lam); n+ik = sqrt(eps); lam in um
note: EMode built-in TiO2 has k=0 everywhere (checked via em.refractive_index): a visible-range-only fit that silently drops the strong UV absorption at the SH band. This fit replaces it for the loaded-family strip_eq. SH-band (215-235 nm) n,k are well constrained and agree with the raw Siefke table to ~1-3%. Pump-band (430-470 nm) k has a residual of ~0.01-0.02 (alpha ~1.5-3e4 dB/cm) vs the real data's near-zero (~1e-4) -- a fit artifact of the shared power-law damping, not a real absorption feature; treat pump-mode loss from this strip_eq as an upper bound and cross-check against measured waveguide loss before trusting it quantitatively.
